title: Refresh the purchase order match warnings of a draft line as soon as it is edited
summary: Purchase order match warnings now refresh immediately when a draft line is edited, eliminating stale warning messages after the user corrects values like unit cost.
key_points: Line is saved and warnings recalculated before page refresh when editing Quantity, Direct Unit Cost, Line Discount, Line Type, No., or Unit of Measure
Corrected lines now show 'No warnings' status immediately instead of retaining previous warnings
Warnings column disappears once no line has warnings
Aligns behavior with purchase order subform which saves before recalculating totals
Low risk change with minimal performance impact
